mapper.select: select resource_id,type from appointment where appoint_date <#{end} and appoint_date >= #{start} group by resource_id,type order by sum(1) desc limit 0,1

select case when a.type = 'RESOURCE' then r.name else f.name end as name,sum(1) as count from appointment as a left join resource as r on a.resource_id = r.id and a.type = 'RESOURCE' left join facility as f on a.resource_id = f.id and a.type = 'VENUE' where a.appoint_date < #{end} and a.appoint_date >= #{start} group by a.resource_id,a.type order by count desc limit 0,5
